title: VXAce VX ACE Weird Text Compression/Blur Fix

posts.author: burntretinas744
posts.body: So! I've been working on a little project in VXAce and noticed that the text is very blurry and ugly. I'm using a custom font and Fullscreen++ but even without them active it still looks compressed and ugly... I've tried using other fonts and they all have the same compression. Is there anything I can do about this or do I just have to deal with it?

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
it's a compound problem... partly the program's inability to scale fonts, and partly the font's own sizes not being adequate.
make sure you use pixel fonts, since vectors will have scale problems.
also, I'm sure there's a way to remove anti-alias... maybe that's the problem.
I had the same problem, and I fixed with a mix of using different font types for each size, controlling AA, and making the UI *to* the font instead of the other way around.

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
I have a few questions which might help you pin this down. Something similar happened in one of my projects.
What is the standard resolution?
What is the full screen resolution?
What is your font size?
Does blurring/tearing occur in standard resolution?
How much occurs in full screen?
What is the estimated font size when full screen?
In my MZ project, it was a size mismatch. It looked right at standard at first, then I customized the font and it looked incorrect, and it turned out nothing to do with the full screen. I still have issues with larger sprites, but it is still a work in progress.
With some quick Googling, you could replace the font with
Sfont
. Or you could go for the retro vibe with
Orms
.
